🛵 #Full·Time #Remote
📚 #Visual·Designer #Design
💰 Compensation: Negotiable, Base salary + yearly bonus

1️⃣ Lead marketing campaign design
Own the visual direction and execution of acquisition campaigns, engagement initiatives, trading competitions, seasonal promotions, and anniversary celebrations. Develop concepts, key visuals, landing pages, banners, and supporting assets that communicate clearly and support conversion goals.
2️⃣ Create social media visuals
Design brand graphics, promotional posts, timely content, and recurring visual series for platforms including X, Instagram, and Telegram. Adapt layouts and creative approaches to each channel’s audience and format.
3️⃣ Produce and scale AI-generated 3D visuals
Use AI tools to quickly create illustrations, scenes, and marketing assets based on an established 3D visual style. Maintain control over composition, materials, lighting, and detail, and build repeatable workflows that deliver consistent, production-ready results.
4️⃣ Develop AI-assisted storyboards and simple animations
Translate scripts into visual treatments, shot compositions, and storyboard keyframes. Use AI tools to create animated social graphics, illustration motion, product showcases, and transitions, ensuring coherent pacing and visual continuity.
5️⃣ Maintain brand expression and consistency
Develop a thorough understanding of the brand’s positioning, audience, and visual language. Apply that understanding across campaigns, channels, and formats while introducing fresh creative ideas appropriate to each brief.
6️⃣ Deliver projects and build reusable design assets
Collaborate with marketing, campaign operations, copywriting, and video teams. Manage competing priorities, oversee final output quality, and improve design templates, asset libraries, and visual guidelines.

🌵 Requirements:
1️⃣ At least five years of visual design experience in digital products, fintech, or Web3, with the ability to independently lead major marketing design projects.
2️⃣ Strong campaign design skills, with experience creating key visuals, landing pages, and coordinated assets across channels. Able to communicate campaign mechanics, benefits, and calls to action clearly.
3️⃣ Proven ability to create 3D-style visuals using AI, accurately matching an established visual direction through reference images, prompt development, and controlled generation workflows. Strong retouching and finishing skills are essential.
4️⃣ A strong portfolio of social media design, demonstrating expertise in typography, layout, color, and graphic composition, with consistent quality across high-volume content.
5️⃣ A strong understanding of visual communication for European and North American audiences, including English-language typography, font pairing, spacing, and information hierarchy.
6️⃣ Hands-on experience with AI-assisted storyboarding and simple animation, supported by an understanding of shot composition, narrative pacing, and motion principles. Able to combine image-to-video tools with editing, compositing, and refinement to produce usable marketing content.
7️⃣ Excellent judgment in brand expression and consistency, with the ability to evaluate typography, imagery, materials, color, and motion against brand standards across channels and languages.
8️⃣ A strong interest in blockchain, digital assets, and Web3, with a willingness to understand the products, audiences, and marketing objectives behind each brief.
Required Experience
1️⃣ Design experience with a crypto exchange, digital wallet, or financial brand serving international markets.
2️⃣ Demonstrable examples of standardized AI workflows, batch asset generation, or production automation.
3️⃣ Experience collaborating with international teams and the ability to communicate effectively in #English at work.

Telegram: @shaliwalisha
